scope: Cross-jurisdiction synthesis of the China, US and route evidence. Conditional decision support, not a personalized tax calculation or a cheapest-provider claim.
headline: The best first step is to identify the lawful source of the CNY and use the matching documented bank/approval route. Conversion fees, income tax, currency gain/loss and reporting penalties are different costs; no single tax-penalty percentage can be verified from the facts supplied.

decision_steps.step: Classify the money, not just the passport
decision_steps.action: Reconstruct salary, business income, dividends, interest, asset-sale proceeds, inheritance, prior exchange and principal by year. Confirm the bank's inside/outside-individual classification and the user's Chinese/US tax residence separately.
decision_steps.why: Evidence and tax treatment follow the actual source/status; US citizenship alone does not select a route.
decision_steps.output: A source-of-funds schedule and status checklist; unknown fields remain blank.

decision_steps.step: Check prior tax and information reporting before moving funds
decision_steps.action: Review US returns, FBAR, Form 8938 and any trust/entity/gift forms; review Chinese tax evidence and emigration clearance where applicable. If omissions exist, obtain fact-specific advice on the correct compliance process before relying on a transfer workaround.
decision_steps.why: A wire does not cure prior noncompliance; streamlined relief is conditional and not automatic amnesty.
decision_steps.output: A compliance gap list; no assumption that the user is delinquent.

decision_steps.step: Use the genuine income/asset route first
decision_steps.action: Salary/current income: documented bank route. Qualifying pre-status wealth: immigration-property approval. Genuine inheritance: inheritance approval. Genuine property/FDI proceeds: the corresponding net-proceeds/registration process.
decision_steps.why: These routes match the legal source instead of forcing unrelated savings through a fabricated transaction.
decision_steps.output: One or more legally supported route candidates.

decision_steps.step: Screen providers only after eligibility is established
decision_steps.action: Check Wise's non-mainland origin/work/tax-record and own-account rules; check Western Union partner-bank/passport/country controls and cash-pickup-only limitation. Treat MoneyGram and Remitly outbound-China availability as unverified on the retrieved evidence.
decision_steps.why: A brand's inbound-to-China service or generic global page is not proof of outbound-CNY availability.
decision_steps.output: Executable provider shortlist, or an explicit unverified result.

decision_steps.step: Compare like-for-like delivered USD, not advertised fees
decision_steps.action: For the same CNY debit, timestamp, destination and delivery method, record the customer FX rate, all CNY/USD fees, intermediary/receiving charges, amount actually delivered and expected arrival. Include document/approval costs where relevant.
decision_steps.why: A zero transfer fee can hide an FX spread; an inbound promotional quote is not an outbound quote.
decision_steps.output: A quote table with blanks for any missing component; no inferred cheapest provider.

decision_steps.step: Model tax separately from execution cost
decision_steps.action: Compute Chinese tax on the actual income/disposition, then US tax/FTC/FEIE where applicable, then any separate currency gain/loss and NIIT/payroll exposure. Keep information-reporting penalties conditional on actual past conduct.
decision_steps.why: The transfer amount is not a universal tax base and a provider cannot change the underlying income category.
decision_steps.output: Separate tax and non-tax cost lines; personalized amounts remain blank.

decision_steps.step: Use cash/card only for the need they actually serve
decision_steps.action: Use card spending for genuine expenses; ATM/carrying for limited cash needs within the published limits and permits. Declare correctly on US entry and never split family/group funds to evade reporting.
decision_steps.why: Cash and card access are not scalable substitutes for a documented large-balance wire.
decision_steps.output: A small-amount access plan, not a large-balance repatriation claim.

decision_steps.action: Do not use crypto/underground banks, quota splitting, false contracts, fabricated dividends/sales or ownership relabelling. Do not create a company, trust, insurance policy or investment product merely to move savings.
decision_steps.why: These add legal, tax, reporting, counterparty and market risk rather than verified tax savings.

conditional_recommendations.condition: Balance is documented lawful salary/current income and the bank classifies the user as a qualifying outside individual
conditional_recommendations.recommendation: Start with the handling bank's documented conversion-and-wire process; compare an eligible Wise transfer only if its origin/tax-record/own-account conditions are met.
conditional_recommendations.rationale: Directly matches the source and avoids creating a new taxable transaction.
conditional_recommendations.flag: Not a finding that the user's balance is salary or that Wise eligibility exists.

conditional_recommendations.condition: User meets the foreign/HK/Macao/Taiwan status and pre-status asset conditions
conditional_recommendations.recommendation: Investigate immigration-property transfer approval for the qualifying assets.
conditional_recommendations.rationale: Purpose-built capital-account route; staged-remittance rule was removed and the approval guide publishes no numerical quantity limit.
conditional_recommendations.flag: Eligibility and acquisition dates are unverified.

conditional_recommendations.condition: Funds are genuine inheritance or property/FDI exit proceeds
conditional_recommendations.recommendation: Use the matching inheritance/property-sale/FDI process with tax, title/registration and net-proceeds evidence.
conditional_recommendations.rationale: The legal source has a dedicated process; forcing it through a salary quota would misstate the transaction.
conditional_recommendations.flag: No such asset/inheritance facts were supplied.

conditional_recommendations.condition: Both banks support lawful current-account cross-border RMB and the overseas conversion quote is competitive
conditional_recommendations.recommendation: Consider sending RMB through the bank and converting abroad.
conditional_recommendations.rationale: May avoid an in-China conversion bottleneck while retaining bank records.
conditional_recommendations.flag: Receiving-bank acceptance, offshore rate and all fees are unverified.

conditional_recommendations.condition: Only a small amount of travel/residual cash is needed
conditional_recommendations.recommendation: Use genuine card spending, the ATM quota, or the published RMB/foreign-cash carrying rules with required permits and US declaration.
conditional_recommendations.rationale: These are access methods with explicit limits, not a strategy for a large stuck balance.
conditional_recommendations.flag: Issuer/provider costs and travel facts are unverified.

conditional_recommendations.condition: Source/status cannot be documented or a provider rejects the user
conditional_recommendations.recommendation: Obtain the bank's written missing-evidence/refusal explanation and resolve the actual source/status issue; do not substitute a prohibited workaround.
conditional_recommendations.rationale: The official guide requires banks to explain refusals, and anti-splitting/penalty rules make evasion a poor optimization.
conditional_recommendations.flag: The actual refusal reason is unknown.

definitions.definition: Total CNY debited from the China account, including any CNY-side fixed fee.
Fixed fees deducted in CNY before conversion, translated consistently.
Provider's effective USD per CNY rate actually applied to the converted amount. If quoted as CNY per USD q, use r_customer = 1/q only when q is the all-in customer rate with no hidden adjustment.
Independent mid-market USD per CNY reference at the same timestamp, used only for comparison.
USD fees deducted after conversion, including disclosed intermediary/receiving charges where known.

formulas.name: Delivered USD
formulas.condition: Use only when the quote actually deducts fees in this order; otherwise follow the provider's disclosed calculation.

formulas.name: FX spread cost in USD
formulas.condition: Same timestamp and rate direction; not a tax.

formulas.name: Total execution cost versus fee-free mid-market conversion
formulas.formula: Execution cost = A × m - D = F_cny × m + Spread + F_usd
formulas.condition: Excludes income tax, currency-gain tax, penalties, travel/document costs and market risk; add those separately only when actually applicable and verified.

components.basis: Actual income/disposition, residence, deductions/exemptions and treaty position; not the transfer fee.

components.component: US residual income tax after lawful relief
components.basis: Worldwide income, FEIE/FTC interaction, categories, limitation and treaty saving clause.
Functional currency, CNY basis, disposition and personal/business character under section 988.
components.flag: User amount blank; current Code consolidation review flag retained.

components.basis: Actual investment income/MAGI or work arrangement; not triggered merely by choosing a wire provider.
Live customer rate versus same-time mid-market reference.
Actual bank/provider quote and delivery method.
Official approval guides say no administrative approval fee; translation/authentication, bank execution and travel are separate.
Only if actual past noncompliance and the applicable procedure establish them; streamlined domestic 5% uses a defined covered-asset base.
components.flag: No delinquency assumed; user amount blank.

tax_scenarios.analysis: The matching bank/provider route moves principal; review any later currency gain/loss and account reporting rather than taxing the entire balance again by assumption. This is not a blanket transfer-tax exemption.

tax_scenarios.scenario: Salary or investment income omitted from prior US returns
tax_scenarios.analysis: The transfer channel does not cure the omission. Reconcile returns and consider conditional compliance procedures with professional review; do not assume non-willfulness.
Apply China's actual exemption conditions and US gain/basis/main-home rules separately. Remittable net proceeds and taxable gain are different amounts.
tax_scenarios.flag: No sale facts or basis supplied.

tax_scenarios.analysis: China's current individual rule is 20% IIT under Announcement 2026 No.27; US tax/FTC and any treaty claim are separate. Do not use the repealed exemption or substitute the corporate 10% rate.
tax_scenarios.flag: Distribution date, treaty residence and US residual tax unknown.

tax_scenarios.analysis: A genuine foreign gift/bequest is generally an amount excluded from gross income under the IRS definition, but Form 3520 reporting can apply above the relevant threshold; foreign-trust distributions follow different rules. China remittance permission still needs its own basis.
tax_scenarios.flag: No gift/inheritance facts supplied; do not relabel own savings.

tax_scenarios.scenario: Income is genuinely nonconvertible because of foreign-country restrictions
tax_scenarios.analysis: Publication 54's blocked-income election may be relevant, but conversion difficulty or app ineligibility alone is insufficient. Review the actual restriction, prior election and unblocking events.
tax_scenarios.flag: No blocked-income election or legal nonconvertibility established.

tax_scenarios.scenario: Considering crypto, underground settlement or splitting
tax_scenarios.analysis: No verified tax saving outweighs the explicit Chinese prohibitions/penalties and US reporting rules. These are rejected strategies, not optimization options.

myths.myth: USD 50,000 is the maximum a foreign worker can ever remit.
myths.correction: It is a facilitation quota; documented qualifying current income and separate capital/approval routes have different rules.

myths.myth: A zero-fee transfer is necessarily cheapest.
myths.correction: Compare delivered USD and the customer FX rate at the same timestamp, including intermediary/receiving charges.

myths.myth: US citizenship makes Wise or Western Union automatically available.
myths.correction: Wise has origin/work/tax-record conditions; Western Union uses partner-bank controls and currently lacks direct bank-account delivery on the cited page.

myths.myth: The treaty lets a US citizen choose to pay only Chinese tax.
myths.correction: The protocol preserves US citizen taxation subject to listed exceptions; credit relief is subject to US law.

myths.myth: FEIE excludes the whole CNY balance or investment proceeds.
myths.correction: FEIE is qualifying earned-income relief for the relevant work year; dividends, interest, gains and pensions are not earned income.

myths.myth: FBAR's USD 10,000 threshold is a tax-free transfer allowance.
myths.correction: It is an aggregate foreign-account reporting threshold, including accounts with no taxable income.

myths.myth: USD 200 of personal currency gain is always tax-free and only the excess is taxed.
myths.correction: The cited section 988(e) exclusion does not apply when otherwise recognized personal-transaction gain exceeds USD 200; business/investment character and functional currency matter.

myths.myth: Carrying cash avoids tax and reporting.
myths.correction: China exit limits/permits and US entry reporting still apply; underlying income/FX tax is separate.

myths.myth: The new US 1% remittance excise applies to money arriving from China.
myths.correction: The verified IRS scope concerns specified physical-instrument-funded remittances sent from the US to foreign recipients; do not add it to an inbound wire by default.

myths.myth: A company, trust, insurance policy or QDII product is a free repatriation wrapper.
myths.correction: These are genuine legal/investment arrangements with their own controls and potential US reporting; they do not create a general right to move unrelated savings abroad.

flags.topic: No personalized best route or tax total
flags.finding: Balance, source, residence/status, asset history, filings, bank and destination are unknown.
flags.resolution: Publish conditional recommendations and blank user-specific values; do not infer.

flags.finding: No comparable live outbound quotes were supplied or verified.
flags.resolution: Use the delivered-USD formula and leave all prices blank until like-for-like quotes exist.

flags.finding: Primary/official sources now support the RMB 20,000 limit and foreign-cash permit tiers; failed web pages are not cited as evidence.
flags.resolution: Supersede the earlier T1 retrieval limitation with the T3 source set.

flags.finding: Section 988 was read in the official 2024 Code; MoneyGram/Remitly outbound products, bank drafts and detailed FDI checklists remain unverified.
flags.resolution: Keep edition/availability flags visible on Flagged for Review.
